system.description:
You perform a full power strike, putting all of your weight and momentum behind this strike.

If this jutsu is cast targeting a creature who is gaining the benefits of damage Reduction or Resistance, you ignore them for this jutsu’s damage roll.

Make a melee taijutsu attack dealing your [Unarmed damage] + 5d8.

Finisher: on a hit, you instead deal your [Unarmed damage] + 7d8, and the target must make a constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they are shaken as become Staggered until the end of their next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d8.
